images.caption: Figure 2:Overview ofDONIC.Top:BiHOI captures are reconstructed and retargeted, then combined with public-data references to form the training pool.Middle:A shared bimanual policy learns through simulated interaction and verified demonstrations in an iterative PPO+BC loop.Bottom:An object-centered per-hand reward, Clip-Centered Advantages (CCA), and behavioral cloning provide complementary learning signals.
Figure 3:Qualitative comparisons on two held-out object trajectories. Rows show the reference, Dexplore-bi, DexTrack-bi, andDONIC; time runs left to right.

Figure S1:Reconstruction and annotation pipeline.Synchronized multi-view RGB observations are processed to obtain SAM3 object masks and metric depth maps. The object branch performs metric reconstruction followed by robust multi-view 6D tracking, while the hand branch performs participant-specific hand calibration and multi-view hand-pose reconstruction. The two branches are finally refined jointly using depth-guided hand–object optimization.
